title: Christmas Bible Crossword Puzzle — the Nativity Story
heading: The Christmas Bible Crossword
description: A Christmas Bible crossword from Luke 2 and Matthew 2: the manger, the shepherds, the star, and the wise men. Play the nativity story free on iPhone and iPad.
prose: A stable in Bethlehem, swaddling clothes, a manger for a crib — the Christmas story fits a crossword grid as naturally as it fits a carol. The Christmas Story draws its clues from Luke 2 and Matthew 2: Mary and Joseph, the heavenly host, peace on earth, and the star in the east.

The nativity runs deeper in the archive too: Wise Men from the East follows the magi, while the minis Born in Bethlehem and Heavenly Host make a two-minute Advent habit. Every one closes on a verse from the story it tells.

clues.text: Animal shelter where the birth took place
Feeding trough used as a crib

verseText: And she brought forth her firstborn son, and wrapped him in swaddling clothes, and laid him in a manger; because there was no room for them in the inn.
